note: R1 pins no approval key. The pin of the approval authority lives in the SOURCE (core/r1_approval.py::PINNED_PUBLIC_KEY) and this file is its mirror for the audit trail: the gate uses the source pin only when this mirror carries exactly the same key, and refuses every approval when the two disagree (fail closed). The key belongs to the maintainer: its private half never enters this repository and never enters the process, and no step of the evidence-regeneration workflow has been approved yet. A null key means that no approval artifact can be verified and therefore that no provider dispatch can be authorised - the intended state of R1 (every stage is PROVISIONAL_ONLY / NOT_DISPATCHABLE). The key is added here AND to the source when the maintainer approves a step; the artifact itself is handed to the run out of band.
